description: Show which wallet this ZeroDust server signs with, where its key comes from, and which destinations it is allowed to sweep to. Call this before any sweep to confirm the right wallet is about to be emptied. Requires ZERODUST_ALLOW_EXECUTE=true plus a signing key; without them this tool returns an error and moves no funds. Pass dryRun=true to rehearse the whole flow without moving anything.
name: zerodust_get_agent_address
